verdict.rationale: Name.com documents an availability check for up to 50 names at once, returning pricing for each, and its site offers bulk search, premium names and expiring-domain browsing. That covers the core availability lookup. Nothing in the pack shows alternate-TLD suggestions or any commitment against front-running searched names, and nothing evidences search speed. Missing for 10: alternate TLD suggestion feature, evidence of instant/fast lookups, explicit no-front-running/no-squatting policy, independent or hands-on corroboration of search honesty.
